title: Last-Mile Delivery Routing System
description: An optimization engine and driver app for planning the most efficient delivery routes for a fleet of vehicles.

modules.name: Route Optimization Engine
modules.description: Solving the Vehicle Routing Problem (VRP) considering time windows and vehicle capacities.

modules.name: Driver Mobile App
modules.description: Turn-by-turn navigation and proof-of-delivery (signature/photo) capture.

modules.name: Dispatcher Dashboard
modules.description: Live map view tracking all vehicles and delivery statuses in real-time.

modules.name: Customer Tracking Link
modules.description: SMS link for customers to track their package live on a map.

project_objectives: Provide accurate ETA predictions within a 15-minute window

title: Warehouse Management System (WMS)
description: A comprehensive system to manage warehouse operations, including receiving, putaway, picking, packing, and shipping.

modules.name: Inventory Bin Tracking
modules.description: Tracking exact 3D locations (aisle, rack, shelf) of every item.

modules.name: Barcode Scanning Integration
modules.description: API endpoints optimized for rugged handheld scanners used by warehouse staff.

modules.name: Pick Wave Generation
modules.description: Grouping orders efficiently to minimize walking distance for pickers.

modules.name: Shipping Carrier Integration
modules.description: Generating shipping labels via APIs from FedEx, UPS, and USPS.

title: Freight Forwarding Portal
description: A platform for managing international shipping logistics, customs documentation, and sea/air freight tracking.

modules.name: Quoting Engine
modules.description: Generating freight quotes based on volume, weight, and routes.

modules.name: Document Management
modules.description: Generating and storing Bills of Lading, Commercial Invoices, and Customs forms.

modules.name: Vessel Tracking
modules.description: Integrating with AIS data providers to track container ships on oceans.

modules.name: Milestone Alerts
modules.description: Notifying clients when cargo departs, arrives at port, and clears customs.

title: Cold Chain Monitoring System
description: An IoT-based system to monitor temperature and humidity of sensitive cargo (like vaccines) in transit.

modules.name: IoT Telemetry Ingestion
modules.description: Handling high-frequency MQTT data streams from sensors in refrigerated trucks.

modules.name: Alerting Engine
modules.description: Triggering SMS/Emails instantly if temperature deviates from the safe range.

modules.name: Compliance Reporting
modules.description: Generating unalterable temperature logs required by FDA/health authorities.

modules.name: Fleet Analytics
modules.description: Dashboards to identify trucks with failing refrigeration units over time.

project_objectives: Process thousands of sensor readings per second
Ensure zero data loss for compliance records

title: On-Demand Courier App
description: A platform connecting local businesses with independent bike and car couriers for same-day urban deliveries.

modules.name: Order Creation API
modules.description: Allowing local restaurants/shops to push delivery requests directly from their POS.

modules.name: Courier Bidding/Assignment
modules.description: Broadcasting available jobs to nearby couriers to accept.

modules.name: Earnings Tracker
modules.description: Tracking completed jobs and calculating weekly payouts for couriers.

modules.name: Live Support Chat
modules.description: Connecting couriers, merchants, and customers in a 3-way chat.

project_objectives: Assign couriers to jobs within 2 minutes
